episode_row: Hetzner cutover deploy pull / restart silently failing

commits.subject: fix(deploy): add safe.directory for git pull (was silently failing)
fix(deploy): use user-level systemctl for bts service restart
commits.body:
Root can't see user-level systemd units without XDG_RUNTIME_DIR.
Previous `systemctl restart` silently failed since the units only
exist under the bts user's service manager.
